verdict.rationale: The quickstart docs explicitly describe signing up at console.x.ai, loading credits, and creating an API key via the API Keys page with no sales contact required, followed by runnable code examples — exactly matching the self-serve onboarding story. Pricing, rate limits, and model catalog docs further support a frictionless self-serve path. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a developer that the signup flow works without any gated waitlist in practice.
